cards.name: Pieces of the Puzzle
cards.oracleText: Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put up to two instant and/or sorcery cards from among them into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

cards.name: Piece It Together
cards.oracleText:
Starting intensity 1
Draw a card. If Piece It Together's intensity is 4, instead take an extra turn after this one.
Cards you own named Piece It Together intensify by 1.
